import numpy as np, collections
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; Hh=len(g); Ww=len(g[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # divider: column whose color count > half of its occupied height, spanning most rows
    div=None
    for c in range(Ww):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(Hh)]
        cnt=collections.Counter(vals)
        bestcol=max(cnt, key=cnt.get) if False else None
        # candidate: color that appears in nearly every row and isn't bg
        occ=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
        cnt_c=collections.Counter(occ)
        if len(cnt_c)==1 or cnt_c.most_common(1)[0][1]>=len(occ)*0.9:
            div=(c,bestcol:=cnt_c.most_common(1)[0][0])
    out=[[bg]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    for r in range(Hh):
        for c in range(Ww):
            v=g[r][c]
            if div and c==div[0] and v==div[1]: continue
            nc=c+1 if div and c<div[0] else c
            out[r][nc]=v
    return out
for i in [6,7]:
    print(i, f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
